_README: Carrier tracking store consumed by scripts/lib/po-delivery.mjs (PO_CARRIER_TRACKING_FILE, default data/out/po/carrier-tracking.json). Copy this template to carrier-tracking.json and fill REAL values. The engine fails closed on placeholders (TODO/XXXX/TBD/n/a) and on numbers shorter than 6 chars; it never invents tracking references. 'events' is optional carrier scan history (label_created -> in_transit -> delivered). A PO only reaches 'delivered' when a REAL signed receipt scan exists under receivedDir (default data/out/po/received/<PO>/<carrier>-*.pdf|jpg|png) — that is a physical human step.
